title: Input OTP
description: Six boxes for a code that arrives somewhere else — typed, pasted, or autofilled as one.
usage: For verification codes and short PINs. One component, one inputmode, no per-box tab stops to fight with.
a11y: Each box is a real input with inputmode="numeric" and autocomplete="one-time-code" on the first, so password managers and SMS autofill land properly. Arrow keys and paste are handled.
